project_copy: Convenience attachment only. Compare revision and refresh from GitHub; no automatic synchronization.
rules: Owner listening prevails over tags. Keep artist and label geography separate. Never reassign already completed listening on the basis of an unrecovered track verdict.

states.qualified: Accepted jungle evidence or explicitly independently resolved allocation
states.contextual: Investigated, adjacent or insufficient jungle evidence
states.provenance_required: Musical case established; independent country evidence missing
states.prior_listening_verdict_unrecovered: Already heard; precise track verdict unknown and not a new assignment

artist_provenance.location: North Queensland / Gurrumbilbarra (Townsville); earlier Brisbane links
artist_provenance.notes: Nate Swan's 2022 Foreign Frequencies EP The Year My Voice Broke is credited as a Gurrumbilbarra local production; track 7 is a two-minute digital preview of a physical-only 40-minute cassette B-side DJ mix. Owner accepted the mix as jungle. This supports Australian DJ/selector participation, not original jungle production. Original release Initiate / No Contact with Lithe has no recovered jungle listening verdict.
